The '''Lightning 22''' was a model of [[Ion grenade/Legends|ion grenade]] produced by [[Kirgo Blastworks/Legends|Kirgo Blastworks]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and cost 65 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. It could deactivate all [[Droid/Legends|droids]] caught in the blast radius.<ref name="Dangerous Covenants" />
